aboutGame.title: What is Wonderful Neoran Valley?
paragraphs: Wonderful Neoran Valley is a narrative-driven roguelite monster collector from Nara Studio. You play as the Knight, a Neura-enhanced soldier whose foresight reveals enemy actions several turns ahead through the Timeline. Rather than catching creatures, you recruit intelligent Neoran through battlefield dialogue, and each recruit adds new actions and a unique Synapse option.

Battles reward efficient planning over brute force. Jewels grant team-wide passive bonuses, Sigils modify individual Neoran actions, and Traits can affect every creature on the field. The game is targeting a 2028 launch on PC via Steam, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch 2, with more than 70 recruitable Neoran promised at base scope.

modules.name: Wonderful Neoran Valley Beginner Guide
modules.description: Start with the confirmed basics: the Timeline, Synapse, Neura charges, Jewels, Sigils, Traits, and dialogue-based recruitment.

highlights.detail: Read the Timeline to see enemy Neoran actions several turns ahead.
Recruit Neoran through battlefield dialogue instead of capture devices.
Use Synapse during the planning phase by spending Neura charges.
Equip Jewels for team-wide bonuses and Sigils for individual actions.
Win efficiently so attacks, items, and HP remain available for the next fight.

modules.name: Wonderful Neoran Valley Neoran Guide
modules.description: Meet the confirmed Neoran, from Pero and Yakid to named combat examples such as Sagira, Biskem, and Mehtyr.

highlights.label: Pero
highlights.detail: A fearless Valley creature at the bottom of the food chain that communicates by spinning.

highlights.label: Yakid
highlights.detail: A durable coastal clan creature that serves its Wakiza and can detect Neura stockpiles from afar.

highlights.label: Sagira
highlights.detail: A named Neoran whose Silent Assassin can interrupt a powerful Cloudbreak attack.

highlights.label: Biskem
highlights.detail: A wild Neoran shown preparing Cloudbreak with a 300% damage bonus in the trailer.

highlights.label: Mehtyr
highlights.detail: A debate-driven recruit that resists easy agreement and tests how the Knight handles its objections.

highlights.label: Roster
highlights.detail: More than 70 recruitable Neoran are planned at base scope, with evolution confirmed.

modules.name: Wonderful Neoran Valley Combat Guide
modules.description: Master Timeline foresight, action order, team synergy, Neura charges, and resource-efficient planning across every run.

highlights.detail: Read the Timeline to identify incoming enemy actions and combo setups.
Plan offense and defense around action order, not raw damage alone.
Chain switches and specific moves to trigger Neoran synergy effects.
Spend Neura charges on Synapse actions when they can change the turn order.
Conserve attacks, items, and HP for the encounters that follow.

faq.title: Wonderful Neoran Valley FAQ
faq.description: Answers to common questions about Wonderful Neoran Valley, its combat, recruitment, platforms, and release window.

items.question: What is Wonderful Neoran Valley?
items.answer: Wonderful Neoran Valley is a narrative-driven roguelite monster collector from Nara Studio. The Knight uses foresight to read enemy actions through the Timeline, recruits intelligent Neoran through battlefield dialogue, and builds a team with Synapse, Jewels, Sigils, and Traits.

items.question: When does Wonderful Neoran Valley release?
items.answer: Wonderful Neoran Valley is targeting a 2028 release window. Nara Studio has confirmed PC via Steam, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch 2, but no exact launch date has been announced.

items.question: How do you recruit Neoran in Wonderful Neoran Valley?
items.answer: You recruit Neoran by talking to them on the battlefield. Each creature responds differently to the Knight, so matching its personality and objections matters more than using a capture device.

items.question: What is the Timeline in Wonderful Neoran Valley?
items.answer: The Timeline is the combat forecast created by the Knight's foresight. It reveals enemy Neoran actions several turns ahead so you can plan action order, Synapse timing, and team synergies.

items.question: Does Wonderful Neoran Valley have a public demo?
items.answer: No public playable demo for Wonderful Neoran Valley has been announced as of October 29, 2026. The Steam page is live for wishlisting, and the official website and Discord are the main channels for future announcements.
